assumptions.text: Motivating premise stated in the 2023 KEP text: because PodSpec container resources are immutable, changing a Pod's resource allocation requires recreating the Pod.

constraints_dependencies.text: Explicit non-goal: controlling the full lifecycle of a Pod whose in-place resize failed; this is left to the actors that initiated the resize.
Changing a Pod's QoS class without a restart is a non-goal.
Changing Init Container resources without a restart is a non-goal.
Evicting lower-priority Pods to make room for a resize is a non-goal (noted as a possible future enhancement).
In-place resize is restricted to CPU and memory; updating extended resources or any other resource type is a non-goal.
Supporting CPU/memory manager policies other than the default 'None' policy is a non-goal.

initial_state.decision: Support changing CPU and memory resources for running Pods without mandatory Pod or container recreation.

goals.text: Permit CPU and memory resource requests/limits to change in place, without requiring a Pod or container restart.
Allow actors (e.g., users, VPA, StatefulSet, JobController) to decide how to proceed when an in-place resource resize is not possible.
Change the UpdateContainerResources CRI API to take a platform-agnostic ContainerResources parameter so that it works for Windows containers and other non-Linux runtimes, not only Linux.
Extend the ContainerStatus CRI API so the kubelet can query the CPU and memory configuration currently applied to a container.
Define, as a high-level guide rather than a detailed implementation specification, the expected behavior of a container runtime when handling resource updates.

implementation_scope.text: Represent desired resources through mutable PodSpec fields and report allocated/applied resources through PodStatus.
Offer per-resource restart-policy choices to control how container resizes are attempted.
Model resize operation progress through states such as proposed, in progress, deferred and infeasible.

original_alternatives_not_encoded_as_out.description: Scheduler approval of resize was considered; rationale for rejecting it is not documented in this short section.
Checkpointing allocated resources in PodSpec was considered; rationale for rejecting it is not documented in this short section.

quality_attributes.text: Avoid service disruption for stateful, batch, and low-replica workloads; availability and cost are stated concerns.

requirements.text: Distinguish the desired resources declared in the Pod spec from the resources allocated to the Pod on the node and from the actual resources applied to its containers.

Expose, for each resized container resource, why the desired and actual resources differ: whether a proposed resize has not yet been accepted or rejected by the kubelet, has been accepted and is being actuated, is deferred, or has been rejected as infeasible; supplemented by Pod Events at key steps.
